jobs.title: Product Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
Auterion is seeking a Product Marketing Specialist to translate complex autonomy, robotics, and defense technology into clear, market-facing messaging, sales enablement, web content, and campaign materials.

This role partners closely with product, engineering, business development, and marketing to develop technically accurate, customer-focused content for defense and global markets. The ideal candidate has experience marketing defense, aerospace, or other highly technical products and can simplify complex technologies into compelling narratives that resonate with military, government, and commercial audiences. You will play a key role in communicating what Auterion builds, why it matters, and how it delivers mission-critical capabilities in real-world environments.

Responsibilities and Duties

- Develop consistent product positioning, messaging, and use-case narratives for Auterion's autonomy and robotics solutions.

- Partner with product, engineering, and business development teams to translate technical capabilities into compelling customer-facing marketing materials.

- Create content for websites, landing pages, sales enablement, campaigns, presentations, one-pagers, events, and product launches.

- Build use-case narratives that connect product capabilities to customer needs, operational environments, and mission outcomes.

- Support customer-facing teams with clear sales materials, competitive positioning, and value messaging.

- Adapt messaging for different defense audiences, geographic markets, and stages of the customer journey.

- Support product launches, announcements, demonstrations, campaigns, and field events with messaging, collateral, and web updates.

- Collaborate with design, social media, video, PR, and events teams to develop polished, high-impact marketing assets.

Qualifications and Skills

- 2-5 years of experience in product marketing, digital marketing, technical marketing, solutions marketing, sales enablement, or a related role.

- Experience marketing products or technologies within the defense, aerospace, national security, or government sectors is highly preferred.

- Experience marketing complex technical products in B2B and/or B2G environments.

- Strong writing, editing, and communication skills, with the ability to simplify technical concepts for a range of audiences.

- Experience partnering with product, engineering, sales, and business development teams to create accurate and effective marketing content.

- Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

- Experience managing external agencies, designers, video production teams, or PR partners.

- Writing or product marketing portfolio samples required.

- US Citizenship required, with eligibility to obtain clearances.

Salary Range: $75,000 - 120,000

Benefits

- Flexible working hours

- Stock Options

- Unlimited PTO

- Health Insurance (includes dental & vision)

- Medical flex spending

- Life Insurance

- Retirement Plan - 401k with company match

- Enhanced maternity & paternity leave

About Auterion

We are building the leading software platform for AI-powered autonomous systems for enterprise and government customers. Our technology is deployed in real-world defense environments and supports missions where reliability, interoperability, and rapid iteration matter most.

At Auterion, we bring together the sharpest minds who love to solve the hardest problems. Join a vibrant team built on innovation, openness, and excellence, where you’ll be empowered to develop ideas, collaborate across all levels, and make an impact that matters.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
To drive our growth strategy in the dynamic market of autonomous robotic systems in defense we’re looking for a Technical Program Manager who will be responsible for the delivery of customer program deliverables to include hardware, software, and  all product demonstrations. In this position you will have a significant contribution to the growth of the company. You will manage a portfolio of projects and will be accountable for delivering customer projects on-time, in-cost and to full customer satisfaction. This requires a holistic approach to project management covering all major disciplines tailored to the respective project sizes. In this role you will be customer facing and lead internal, cross-organizational project teams.

Responsibilities and Duties

- Manage a portfolio of medium to large customer programs focused on autonomous robotic systems, from contract award through delivery and sustainment.

- Lead cross-functional teams across engineering, integration, manufacturing, and testing to deliver complex HW/SW systems on time and within budget.

- Develop and maintain detailed project plans, schedules, budgets, and risk registers using agile and traditional PM methodologies.

- Coordinate with internal teams, OEM partners, and customers to align program goals, resolve issues, and ensure high-quality outcomes.

- Oversee program financials including cost estimation, budgeting, forecasting, and tracking of financial performance.

- Support proposal responses to customer RFIs and RFPs, ensuring technical accuracy, strategic alignment, and competitive positioning.

- Ensure compliance with defense and aerospace standards, including export controls and cybersecurity requirements.

- Drive continuous improvement and contribute to the product and technology roadmap with feedback from program execution.

- Support logistics planning for hardware deliveries, field trials, and system deployments

Qualifications and Skills

- 5+ years of product and program management experience, with at least 2 years in a startup or scale-up environment where you owned outcomes, not just coordination

- Track record of shipping a product or major capability from kickoff to customer hands in under 6 months. You will be asked for specifics: what, how long, what you cut to make the date

- Experience managing development of complex hardware/software systems (robotics, automotive, aerospace, industrial, consumer electronics)

- Customer-facing experience with demanding enterprise or government customers

- Demonstrated ability to make decisions with incomplete information and own the consequences. Examples of calls you made without escalation, including ones that went wrong

- Comfort operating without established process: you build the minimum structure a program needs and delete process that slows delivery

- Hands-on technical fluency: you can read an architecture diagram, sit in an engineering standup, and challenge an estimate without a translator

- Fluency in English; German strongly preferred

- German or EU citizenship required

Benefits

- Flexible working hours

- Stock Options

- Generous holiday allowance

- Pension plan

- Extended social security package

- Enhanced maternity & paternity leave

- Wellpass membership

About Auterion

We are building the leading software platform for AI-powered autonomous systems for enterprise and government customers. Our team is supporting the most important missions and solving the most challenging problems.

At Auterion, we bring together the sharpest minds who love to solve the hardest problems. Join a vibrant team built on innovation, openness, and excellence, where you’ll be empowered to develop ideas, collaborate across all levels, and make an impact that matters.
